claims.evidence: MaxQuant summary.txt has two experiments, Repl1_U2OS_mc6A (files 15892-15906) and Repl2_U2OS_mc6A (16473-16487), multiplicity 3. PRIDE protocol: solvent-control cells in heavy, Trichostatin-A cells in medium, light = pre-pulse growth medium; heavy and medium lysates mixed 1:1. 'ciHHV6A' is INFERRED from the experiment name 'mc6A', the PRIDE title (HHV-6A reactivation) and the abstract (U2-OS with chromosomally integrated HHV-6, reactivated with TSA). Source names follow the condition: U2OS-ciHHV6A_repN_trichostatin-A carries SILAC medium and U2OS-ciHHV6A_repN_solvent-control carries SILAC heavy. 'mc6A' matches the lab's BAC-derived mCherry latent HHV-6A U2OS line (Prusty 2018, PMC6125432, per external review); no Cellosaurus entry.

claims.evidence: PRIDE terms SILAC light PRIDE:0000326, medium PRIDE:0000327, heavy PRIDE:0000325; summary.txt Multiplicity=3, Labels0 light. Condition per channel: (a) PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol names the isotope reagents by catalogue number: solvent control = CNLM-291-H ([13C6,15N2]Lys = Lys8) + CNLM-539-H ([13C6,15N4]Arg = Arg10) = HEAVY; Trichostatin A = DLM-2640 ([2H4]Lys = Lys4) + CLM-2265-H ([13C6]Arg = Arg6) = MEDIUM. MaxQuant summary.txt agrees on the label definitions: Labels1 = Arg6;Lys4 (M), Labels2 = Arg10;Lys8 (H). (b) Independent HDAC-inhibitor signature in the authors' proteinGroups.txt (log2 'Ratio H/M normalized', Repl1/Repl2): canonical TSA-induced CDKN1A/p21 -2.98/-3.18 and H1F0 -2.41/-2.77 (higher in medium); E2F/S-phase targets repressed by HDACi G1 arrest are higher in heavy: MCM3 +2.35/+2.24, MCM7 +2.29/+2.32, RRM2 +2.61/+2.65, TOP2A +2.41/+2.90, CCNB1 +2.61/+2.48. Lower global new synthesis in medium (median raw H/L 0.55/0.49 > M/L 0.43/0.39) also fits TSA growth arrest. Both replicates share the orientation (log2 H/M rep1 vs rep2 Pearson r = 0.857, n = 2744). The abstract states only biological directions, never a label assignment (see limitations).

Light channel = proteins synthesised before the pulse in BOTH arms (light pre-culture), mixed 1:1; not a single treatment arm.
Heavy and medium pulse-labelled lysates were mixed 1:1; their pre-existing (light) proteins are therefore a pool of both arms.
Each newly synthesised (heavy or medium) proteome derives from one treatment arm only.

limitations: Full text of the paper (ImmunoHorizons 2020;4(4):201, CC-BY-NC-ND gold OA) could not be retrieved: publisher/OUP and immunohorizons.org return Cloudflare 403, Europe PMC has no PMC copy, Unpaywall download 403. Only the abstract and the PRIDE protocol text (which appears copied from the paper's Methods, it cites reference '(57)') were used.

Abstract-direction discrepancy (curator note, not the basis of the map): the abstract (PMID 32327453) says dUTPase/thymidylate synthase are 'strongly induced' and SOD2/fatty-acid-oxidation proteins 'strongly inhibited' by HHV-6 reactivation. With medium = TSA, the deposited H/M ratios (proteinGroups/pgFilt6: TYMS log2 H/M +4.99/+2.96, DUT +2.98/+3.52, SOD2 -2.65/-2.76) show the opposite in the TSA arm, so the paper's directional statements appear to be phrased relative to the H/M ratio as reported. The abstract never states a label assignment. Round 2 of this annotation wrongly read it as heavy = TSA; review round 2 (blocker B1) reverted that. The full text (unreachable here) should be checked by a human curator.
No label swap between replicates: log2 H/M normalized ratios of rep1 vs rep2 correlate positively (Pearson r=0.857, n=2744 proteins), so both replicates use the same orientation.

ciHHV-6A status of the U2OS cells is inferred (experiment name 'U2OS_mc6A', PRIDE title, abstract); the clone (lab's mCherry-BAC HHV-6A U2OS line, Prusty 2018) has no Cellosaurus entry so parental U2OS (CVCL_0042) is annotated and the derivative is only named in source name.

Light (pre-existing proteome) channel annotated as a 1:1 pool of the two arms, treatment 'not applicable'; an alternative encoding would omit the light channel, but MaxQuant searched multiplicity 3 and reports M/L and H/L ratios.
TSA concentration, solvent identity, and culture medium have no usable term or source (McCoy's 5A has no NCIT term); characteristics[culture medium], dose and compound columns omitted.
precursor mass tolerance 4.5 ppm inferred from 'MaxQuant default settings' + evidence.txt mass errors (no mqpar.xml deposited).
techsdrf not installed: raw-file metadata verified only by HTTP-range reading of the first 400 KB of two .raw headers.

parse_sdrf warns that SN=... in characteristics[pooled sample] is not one of the allowed values; the same template's pattern validator explicitly allows SN=a;SN=b (template-internal conflict), so the warning is accepted.

characteristics[developmental stage] deliberately NOT added: the donor was 15Y, which is HsapDv:0000086 'adolescent stage' (13-19 years). The only EFO candidates are 'adult' EFO:0001272 (defined as having attained sexual maturity and full growth: wrong for a 15-year-old) and 'juvenile stage' UBERON:0034919 (sexual maturity not reached: not supported). The column is validated against EFO and HsapDv adolescent stage is not in EFO, so it is left out; age 15Y carries the information.
